workload: 80,000 list-item resource URLs that share one collection path (sites/site-id/lists/list-id/items/item-id).
idea: to_url inserts every segment at the front of a list, so each item recopies the shared parent path; appending the segments and reversing once builds the same URL.

workload: Read the 17 selected columns of 18,000 hydrated users, the column scan a directory export does after the page is loaded.
idea: get_property resolves the Python attribute, and runs to_snake_case for an undeclared column, even when the page already stored the value; returning that stored value first leaves an unloaded name on the getter path and does not change a stored field, including None.

workload: Hydrate 1,000 calendar events (a busy shared calendar for a year), each with start, end, location, organizer, body, and two attendees.
idea: set_property looks up the storage key and runs deserialize_value for every nested field; remembering that plan per value class and storing a value whose Python type is already the declaration leaves date-time strings and nested objects on the existing path, so the hydrated event is unchanged.
